=== PURPOSE: MECHANICS QA, NOT EDGE DISCOVERY ===
MyClaude_V61 has NO validated edge (walk-forward OOS t=-3.69, gross-negative on every
timeframe). Use this pass to confirm stops/TP1/TP2/trail actually TRIGGER, NOT to
harvest 'best' exit settings to trade. The max of ~285 configs over ~8 weeks is ~3
sigma high by chance even on a true-zero strategy — selection bias, not signal.
NEVER type optimizer winners into the live-armed MyClaude study (real acct 23234705).
